'''Hiffis''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="RAS2" /> located in the [[Hiffis system/Legends|Hiffis system]], a part of the [[Jjannex sector/Legends|Jjannex sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of a lightly guarded warehouse of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was used to store outdated heavy equipment, including a large fleet of mostly well-maintained [[Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle/Legends|Ultra-Light Assault Vehicle]] (ULAV) [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="RAS2" /> [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the Empire<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] carried out a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] raid on the facility that resulted in the theft of usable equipment, most importantly the fleet of ULAVs.<ref name="RAS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hiffis was first mentioned in [[Paul Murphy]]'s [[1990]] ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Hiffis [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
